MASTER CALENDAR JURY
Off Calendar Oct-27-2003 Assigned To Trial Court

COURT TRIAL
Off Calendar Oct-27-2003 Off Calendar
MINI MINUTES: This Cause came as assigned from the Presiding Judge Master Calendar for Court Trial.
Commissioner Sue M. Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha/V. Mack, CSR: Leticia Perez.
Henry Shain, Esq., for Plaintiff Jean Claude Lair also present.
Defendant William Frazier present in pro per.
09:15 am. - Counsel and defendant met in chambers.
09:50 am. - Parties have settled and terms of the settlement read into the record as follows:
Defendant stipulated for judgment of possession for the property located at 1388 California St., #406-A, San Francisco, CA. and money judgment for back due rent total of $2,430.00.
If defendant vacate by noon on Nov. 11, 2003 and return all keys, then Plaintiff waives all past due rent and damages, shall dismiss the action by Nov. 17, 2003.
All parties agreed to the terms of settlement in open court.
Matter is ordered off the trial-calendar.
